name: Perseverance
source:
Be rich or poor, we all have our challenges from lack of status, lack of trust, building a new life from a dreadful past, or lack of compassion and love. How they survive these and other challenges determines how we can persevere through the life we are handed. How will these different lives intertwine (or will they)? How will they handle these challenges? This will determine their PERSEVERANCE.

[From [url=https://www.patreon.com/xpected]Patreon[/url]]
translation:
无论富有还是贫穷，我们都会面临来自缺乏地位、缺乏信任、从可怕的过去建立新生活或缺乏同情心和爱的挑战。他们如何度过这些和其他挑战，决定了我们如何坚持度过我们所面临的生活。这些不同的生活将如何交织在一起（或者将如何）？他们将如何应对这些挑战？这将决定他们的毅力。

[来自[url=https://www.patreon.com/xpected]Patreon[/url]]
